intent: Implement the admitted smallest durable campaign-supervisor slice over existing Mission Control, TaskBoard, RuntimeStateStore, OrchestratorMissionAdapter, and GovernedMissionDispatcher owners. One nonblocking fcntl-fenced service reconciles canonical mission snapshots and separately owned executions; evidence renewal uses exact atomic claim CAS; producer completion remains a candidate until independently accepted; authority and revocation are re-read immediately before effects; control commands preserve queued work and report process, transport, model, and acceptance evidence separately. Publish an atomic read-only JSON projection so an API process never needs the canonical writable SQLite file.

honest_blockers: This slice supplies a durable local supervisor and CLI but does not provision a VPS, model account, provider quota, NATS broker, launchd unit, API server, or dashboard.

A fresh supervisor-cycle receipt proves one completed reconciliation cycle only; a process identifier, lock file, transport acknowledgement, or heartbeat never proves model execution or semantic acceptance.
Producer completion remains candidate output until a separately validated independent acceptance receipt exists; Forge and Merge Master retain promotion and merge authority.
The atomic JSON snapshot is a bounded read model, not a second ledger; canonical mutation remains in TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore.
External A2A identity ambiguity is exposed by a bounded deterministic list API; this packet does not add a risky uniqueness migration or change the imported A2A adapter.
interface_mismatches: MissionSnapshot scans the mission session while Orchestrator executions deliberately use distinct owner sessions; campaign status must project MissionSnapshot and owner references separately.
RuntimeStateStore heartbeat_task_claim is read-then-write and cannot fence evidence renewal; this slice adds an exact compare-and-swap method without changing the schema.
RuntimeStateStore external-A2A lookup is latest-only; this slice adds a bounded deterministic list API so the imported adapter can fail closed on ambiguity in a later patch.
API lifespan and RuntimeGraphViews can initialize writable stores even in read-only boot, so external readers must consume the atomic campaign JSON projection rather than the supervisor SQLite file.
GovernedMissionDispatcher requires injected verified authority; the supervisor must load an exact file-backed lease and current revocation set instead of manufacturing authority.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this implementation commit. Stop the supervisor before rollback; canonical queued tasks are preserved, the JSON projection is disposable, and no schema migration, remote deployment, transport topology, provider credential, promotion, merge, or external publication is introduced.
